cloze.text: The ___ is a molecule that stores genetic instructions, and the ___ is one of the alternative forms of a gene.
A ___ is an allele that shows whenever it is present, while a ___ is a change in the DNA base sequence.

frames: ___ is the molecule that stores genetic instructions as a sequence of bases.
___ is a length of DNA that codes for one polypeptide chain.
___ is one of the alternative forms of a gene.
starters: DNA is the molecule that stores genetic instructions as a sequence of bases...
Gene is a length of DNA that codes for one polypeptide chain...
Allele is one of the alternative forms of a gene...

wordBank.gloss: The molecule that stores genetic instructions as a sequence of bases, organised into genes on chromosomes.
A length of DNA that codes for one polypeptide chain.
One of the alternative forms of a gene, found at the same locus on homologous chromosomes.
The alleles an organism carries for a gene, such as AA, Aa or aa.
The observable trait an organism shows, produced by its genotype and environment.
An allele that shows in the phenotype whenever it is present, even in a heterozygote.
An allele that shows in the phenotype only when no dominant allele is present.
A change in the DNA base sequence; most mutations are neutral, some are harmful, and a rare few are beneficial.
